newsitem.title: USA: Michigan jobless rate inches up in October.
newsitem.headline: Michigan jobless rate inches up in October.

text.p: For the second month in a row, Michigan's unemployment rate rose slightly, hitting 4.8 percent in October, the state's employment security commission reported Wednesday.

The seasonally adjusted jobless rate for October inched up to 4.8 percent on October, compared to 4.7 percent in September and 4.5 percent in August. The October 1995 jobless rate for Michigan was 5.2 percent.
Commission estimates showed that 235,000 people were unemployed in October, compared to 226,000 the previous month.
"Although unemployment increased in October, more people were employed in Michigan than at any other time in our history," said security commission director F. Robert Edwards in a news release.
Commission statistics showed employment totaling 4.64 million in October, a gain of 7,000 jobs from September.
